settings.title: Apple Health
settings.intro: Connect møni with Apple Health: workouts (e.g. from your Apple Watch) and your weight are imported automatically, and your møni workouts are saved to Health.
settings.unavailable: Apple Health isn't available on this device.
settings.denied: That didn't work. You can change permissions anytime in the Health app under Profile → Apps → møni.
settings.writeNutritionHint: Saves calories, protein, carbs and fat of your meals to Health. Edits and deletions are applied too.
settings.reads: møni reads: workouts, active energy and weight.
settings.writes: møni writes: your workouts and, if enabled, your nutrition.
settings.bonusHint: Workouts from Health count toward your workout bonus. If a Health workout overlaps one recorded in møni, it isn't counted twice — møni just takes over the measured calories.
settings.permissionsHint: For privacy, Apple Health doesn't tell apps whether read access was granted. If data is missing, check the permissions in the Health app.
